title: Billing rules
desc_activity: Amount per period, recurrence and target (all enrolled, classes or students). When an enrolment is saved, fees follow these rules when applicable; otherwise the activity’s configured amount applies.
desc_transport: Amount per period, recurrence and target. When a rule applies to an enrolment, fees follow these definitions; otherwise the route amount or per-student override is used.
desc_meal: Amount per period, recurrence and target. When a rule exists for the plan and student, charges follow these definitions; otherwise the plan default or manual enrolment amount applies.
desc_event: Charge amount per student (single instalment) within the event audience. After saving the rule, charges are created/updated automatically for selected classes or students.
dialog_desc: Set the amount per billing period and recurrence (as for tuition).
periods_hint: The number of charges is calculated between start and end month according to recurrence (as for tuition).
generate_all_upfront_hint: Same as tuition: creates every period at once.
delete_desc: This does not remove charges already generated.
